about: Story state every completed run of the chapter ends with, for a skip-to-the-end feature. Curated in tools/questdb/chapters.py; values marked certain = false were worked out by reading the scripts or seen in one real save, not proven for every run.

globals.name: 000_Atriscs1
globals.note: k_sup_galaxymap (read from its disassembly) sets 2 and moves to 262TEL at a take-off while 000_Jedi_Found is 1 to 3, the flag is 0 and the 000_PLAYER_GENDER flag is TRUE; k_262_enter (262tel) sets 1 when the scene plays. Three take-offs come at those counts in every run, so a run of that gender has played it; with the flag FALSE the galaxy map never plays it and the value stays 0 (the editor has no per-gender value; 1 there only blocks a scene that cannot play). Left at 2 or 0 it would not replay after the count is 4
